name: Honya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood bookstore: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at the shop, a point-card guide, a free used-book buyback event notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, an essay about noticing a regular customer's change in taste through good service, a lesson teaching a new part-timer the basics of attaching paper book covers, an explainer on why the shop still writes handwritten recommendation cards by hand, a free book-cover service application guide, a column on how online book sales changed the shop's work, a new-semester textbook reservation rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's skill for judging a used book's condition by hand, and a one-year neighboring-bookstores-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
